verdict.rationale: Stripe has a first-party 'Issuing for agents' feature that issues virtual cards scoped to a single task/session, auto-invalidates them after use, and layers spend controls, real-time authorization, and ML fraud risk scoring — a direct match for least-privilege, scoped credentials for agentic spend. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specific to the agent feature (community evidence predates it and concerns general card acceptance/invitation-only access, not this capability).
